title: ManageWARP
description: a plugin that lets you create, delete and manage your warps with great compatibility.
body:
![MANAGEWARP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bbef71bba94a13249fc12c45226adc459af44540_0.webp)
➡️**ManageWARP** is a plugin that offers you great compatibility and tools for your warps in minecraft!

⚪**This plugin offers you many permissions for the best experience:**

- **managewarp.usewarp** **|** allows you to use all the existing warps.
- **managewarp.warpcreate** **|** allows you to create warps.
- **managewarp.deletewarp** **|** allows you to delete warps.
- **managewarp.warplist** **|** allows you to se the entire list of existing warps.
- **managewarp.reload** **|** allows you to reload the plugin.
- **managewarp.usehelp** **|** allows you to see the plugin help menu.
- **managewarp.admin** **|** with this you get full access to command and permission.

❗**NOTE**❗\
An **operator** of a minecraft world gets full access to permission and commands, even if he has no permissions.

➡️We advise using a plugin like **LuckPerms** to assign this permissions to players.
